title: 第6章 肉身搏杀，子时破局
novel_title: 欠我时间债，天道也得跪着还
content_zh:
苏余在山洞里待了五天。

    渴了喝岩缝滴水，饿了吃辟谷丹，困了靠着洞壁假寐——不敢睡死，一半心思始终悬着。

    其余时间全用来做一件事：等。

    等天道每日凌晨扣他的时间。

    被动扣税是他目前唯一不需要付出额外代价的增长方式，每日得十点时痕。

    更关键的是每一息被动扣除都在为金痕添砖加瓦，每五十点时痕凝一道金痕，这是他唯一能对抗天劫的筹码。

    第五天凌晨子时。

    沙漏震动，绝对静止。

    一息后苏余睁开眼。

    【时痕：99】

    【金痕：2（100/50，已凝成）】

    【黑痕：5】

    【距肉身强化还需1点】

    第二道金痕凝成。

    两道金痕，五道黑痕——距离九道天劫还差四道。

    但两道金痕对五道黑痕，差距仍在。

    这五天他反复揣摩时王碑上的技能，对时间之力有了更深的理解。

    时间爆破的核心是“时序撕裂”，但以他目前的时痕总量，对付炼气中期以上伤害有限，真正的杀招是那一息绝对静止。

    静止之中他可以用猎人的手段——毒、陷阱、敌人的武器——去弥补力量差距。

    此外他还摸索出时间之力的精细操控：范围越小消耗越少。

    如果只停滞周身一尺范围内的时间，理论上只需一息寿命——但精确控制需要高度专注，成功率只有五成。

    正琢磨着，洞外传来脚步声。

    苏余瞬间警觉，抓起百炼钢刀伏低身子贴紧洞壁。

    这把刀上的裂纹已被他用藤蔓缠紧，暂时还能用。

    脚步声由远及近，不止一个人。

    “找了五天了，连个人影都没见着。”

    粗哑低沉的声音——是那天晚上在溪边见过的刀疤脸。

    “林师妹说那小子擅用毒和陷阱，别大意。”

    另一个阴柔的声音是那个炼气六层的年轻男子，“不过能让林师妹吃亏的人可不多。

    一个矿奴没修为，全靠毒和陷阱就把踏雪弄残了，倒有几分本事。

    这小子在矿洞里肯定得了什么好东西——说不定是什么上古遗留的秘宝。”

    “秘宝也好功法也罢，抓到人不就什么都知道了？”

    刀疤脸冷笑，“韩铁炼气四层都栽了，这小子身上要是没点东西，谁信？”

    苏余握紧刀柄无声向洞穴深处挪动。

    这山洞最深处有一条狭窄岩缝通往山体另一侧，成年人侧身都勉强，但他这些天靠辟谷丹果腹身子瘦了一圈，应该能钻过去。

    就在摸到岩缝入口时，洞口的脚步声停了。

    “等等。”

    刀疤脸的声音忽然凝重，“这洞里有东西——一股很淡的血腥味，是人血。”

    苏余心中一凛。

    这刀疤脸好灵的鼻子，他在洞中待了五天，身上的血腥味早已散尽，但辟谷丹药渣的气味和伤口结痂脱落的细微痕迹，竟被此人嗅到了。

    “在洞里！”

    刀疤脸低喝一声抽出腰间长刀。

    刀身漆黑刀刃泛着诡异绿光——淬了毒。

    他冲洞穴深处喊道：“里面的人，出来！

    这山洞是死胡同，你跑不掉的。”
content_en:
Su Yu stayed in the cave for five days.

    When I'm thirsty, I drink water dripping from the cracks in the rock. When I'm hungry, I eat Bigu Pills. When I'm sleepy, I lean against the cave wall and fall asleep - I don't dare to sleep to death, half of my mind is always hanging on.

    The rest of the time is spent doing one thing: waiting.

    Waiting for Tiandao to deduct his time every morning.

    Passive tax deduction is the only way for him to grow without paying extra costs, and he gets ten time marks every day.

    What's more important is that every passive deduction of breath is adding bricks and stones to the golden mark. Every fifty points, the golden mark is condensed into a golden mark. This is his only bargaining chip against the catastrophe.

    At midnight on the fifth day.

    The hourglass vibrates and remains absolutely still.

    After a breath, Su Yu opened his eyes.

    [Time mark: 99]

    [Gold marks: 2 (100/50, condensed)]

    [Black marks: 5]

    [It takes 1 point to strengthen the physical body]

    The second golden trace formed.

    Two golden marks, five black marks - still four short of nine heavenly tribulations.

    But the gap between two gold marks and five black marks is still there.

    In the past five days, he had repeatedly studied the skills on the King of Time Monument and gained a deeper understanding of the power of time.

    The core of Time Explosion is "Time Sequence Tear", but with his current total amount of time traces, the damage to those above the middle stage of Qi Refining is limited. The real killer move is the absolute stillness of that breath.

    While still, he can use a hunter's means - poison, traps, enemy weapons - to make up for the power gap.

    In addition, he also figured out the precise control of the power of time: the smaller the range, the less consumption.

    If you only stop time within one foot of your body, you can theoretically only have one breath of life - but precise control requires a high degree of concentration, and the success rate is only 50%.

    While he was thinking about it, footsteps came from outside the cave.

    Su Yu was instantly alert, grabbed the Baidu Steel Knife and lowered himself close to the cave wall.

    The cracks on the knife have been wrapped tightly with vines, so it can still be used for the time being.

    The footsteps came from far to near, and there were more than one person.

    "I've been looking for him for five days, but I haven't even seen him."

    The rough and low voice - it was the Scarface whom I had seen by the stream that night.

    "Junior Sister Lin said that boy is good at using poisons and traps, so don't be careless."

    Another feminine voice was that of a young man at the sixth level of Qi Refining, "But there are not many people who can make Junior Sister Lin suffer.

    A mining slave with no cultivation level and relying solely on poison and traps crippled Tuxue, so he was quite capable.

    This kid must have gotten something good in the mine—maybe it was some secret treasure left over from ancient times. "

    "Whether it's a secret treasure or a skill, if you catch someone, won't you know everything?"

    The scarred face sneered, "Han Tie's fourth level of Qi Refining is broken. If this kid doesn't have anything on him, who would believe it?"

    Su Yu clenched the handle of the knife and silently moved deeper into the cave.

    There is a narrow rock crevice in the deepest part of the cave that leads to the other side of the mountain. It is difficult for an adult to move sideways, but he has lost a lot of weight these days by relying on the Bigu Pill, so he should be able to get through it.

    Just when he touched the entrance of the rock crevice, the footsteps at the entrance of the cave stopped.

    "Wait."

    Scarface's voice suddenly became solemn, "There is something in this hole - a very faint smell of blood, it's human blood."

    Su Yu's heart trembled.

    Scarface's nose was very good. He had been in the cave for five days, and the smell of blood on his body had long since dissipated. However, the smell of the bigu elixir dregs and the subtle traces of scabs falling off the wounds were actually smelled by this person.

    "In the cave!"

    Scarface shouted and drew out the long knife from his waist.

    The pitch-black blade glowed with a strange green light—the poison was quenched.

    He shouted into the depths of the cave: “People inside, come out!

    This cave is a dead end and you can't escape. "
